### 2. Indra-MarketMind — Real-Time Quantitative AI Market Intelligence Terminal
- **Overview**: A quantitative market analytics and sentiment analysis platform correlating real-time financial news with stock price movements.
- **Key Capabilities**: 5-model NLP sentiment ensemble (FinBERT, RoBERTa, FinGPT), hybrid Prophet + PyTorch Bi-LSTM price forecaster with Monte Carlo risk cones, 19 global exchange radar, 10-microservice mesh, PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector, Redis 7 caching, sub-100ms Vercel Edge response, CyberShield security, automated paper trading with Kelly Criterion risk controls.
- **Live Demo**: https://indra-marketmind.vercel.app/
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/indrajitkumar23541-a11y/Indra-MarketMind

### 3. VELOCITY X — 3D Cyber Highway Racing & Pursuit Game
- **Overview**: Console-grade 3D WebGL highway pursuit racing engine built for modern browsers.
- **Key Capabilities**: Three.js physically based rendering (PBR) automotive clearcoats, 8-wave staggered slalom traffic AI with 32m lookahead, aggressive state police interceptors with physical PIT maneuvers, procedural Web Audio synthesizer, locked 60–120 FPS envelope via pre-allocated object pooling, instanced mesh draw-calls (<45 calls), 20Hz-throttled telemetry bridge, and sub-250KB distribution.
- **Live Demo**: https://indrajitkumar23541-a11y.github.io/VELOCITY-X/
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/indrajitkumar23541-a11y/VELOCITY-X

### 4. Yaadon Ki Duniya — Interactive Audio-Visual Indian Nostalgia Platform
- **Overview**: An immersive cultural web experience bringing vintage Indian memories, radio, and ambient soundscapes to life.
- **Key Capabilities**: 6-environment ambient soundscape engine, zero-latency procedural Web Audio synthesizer, analog 88.5–107.9 MHz FM radio tuner, proprietary 2:1 interleaved playback algorithm balancing 700+ song catalog, dynamic dual-layer audio mixer, sub-300ms stream error recovery, and HTML5 Canvas retro postcard generator.
